mandate_boundary: This product-diligence packet does not select a current holding, set an allocation, authorize an order, promise a return, impose a cash-receipt objective or impose automatic reinvestment.

linked_price_observation.boundary: The linked study is a frozen unadjusted public-price observation, not a total-return or executable strategy backtest.

candidates.name: 华宝现金添益ETF
candidates.research_role: Optional transaction/settlement parking instrument; no required allocation or cash objective.
candidates.structure_and_exposure: Shanghai-listed money-market fund. Its disclosed permitted range includes cash, deposits, repos, central-bank bills, NCDs, short-dated debt instruments and ABS subject to stated limits.

documented_terms.exchange_category_mechanics: SSE ETF FAQ states that some money-market ETFs support same-day trading; actual broker/product eligibility needs a dated check.

candidates.total_return_accounting: Daily income, distributions, price/NAV and any external withdrawal must be reconciled once under a frozen convention; no headline income may stand in for portfolio return.
candidates.r2_gate: Dated per-unit income or NAV, market price, premium/discount, spread/depth, broker fee, settlement and event data with a source-consistent total-return ledger.

candidates.name: 国泰上证5年期国债ETF
candidates.research_role: Defensive duration sleeve in the limited public-price observation.
candidates.structure_and_exposure: SSE five-year Treasury-bond index ETF using optimized sampling; normally at least 90% of NAV is in constituents and substitutes after construction.

documented_terms.tracking_objective: Daily average absolute tracking deviation <=0.2% and annualized tracking error <=2% under normal conditions.
documented_terms.exchange_category_mechanics: SSE bond-ETF guide describes same-day trading/redemption mechanics; the actual broker route and price remain separate checks.

candidates.total_return_accounting: Distributions, bond accrual and price/NAV must enter one consistent ledger exactly once.
candidates.r2_gate: Authorized point-in-time ETF price/NAV/distribution data, index membership, bond accrual/coupon data, actual spread/commission/no-fill observations and market-status coverage.

candidates.name: 华泰柏瑞上证红利ETF
candidates.research_role: Dividend-equity risk sleeve in the limited public-price observation.
candidates.structure_and_exposure: Stock ETF tracking the SSE Dividend Index through complete replication, subject to the stated liquidity exception; normally at least 95% of NAV is in constituents and substitutes.

documented_terms.exchange_category_mechanics: SSE ETF FAQ classifies stock ETFs as T+1 products and gives a 100-unit minimum trading lot for ETFs.

candidates.total_return_accounting: A distribution is a dated ledger event, not a cash target or reinvestment assumption; it must not be added twice to an adjusted/total-return series.
candidates.r2_gate: Point-in-time index membership, price/NAV/distribution/action history, T+1/no-fill treatment, actual costs/spreads and a market-quality packet.

candidates.name: 华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF
candidates.research_role: Broad-A-share risk sleeve in the limited public-price observation.
candidates.structure_and_exposure: Stock index ETF tracking CSI 300 through complete replication; normally at least 95% of NAV is in constituents and substitutes. The product summary permits limited supplementary instruments and securities-lending activity as disclosed.

documented_terms.tracking_objective: Daily average tracking deviation within 0.2% and annualized tracking error within 2% under normal conditions.
documented_terms.exchange_category_mechanics: SSE ETF FAQ classifies stock ETFs as T+1 products and gives a 100-unit minimum trading lot for ETFs.

candidates.total_return_accounting: Dividends and corporate actions require a dated, single-count total-return convention.
candidates.r2_gate: Point-in-time CSI 300 membership, price/NAV/dividend/action history, T+1/no-fill data, actual execution costs and a verified overlap/correlation map against 510880.

candidates.name: 华安易富黄金ETF
candidates.research_role: Domestic-gold risk sleeve in the limited public-price observation.
candidates.structure_and_exposure: Gold ETF targeting domestic gold spot performance; no less than 90% of fund assets are in Shanghai Gold Exchange-listed gold spot contracts.

documented_terms.exchange_category_mechanics: SSE ETF FAQ lists gold ETFs among categories that may support same-day trading; actual broker/product status must be checked at the time of any paper test.

key_risks: correlation instability versus equity and bond sleeves
candidates.total_return_accounting: Use one source-consistent market/NAV convention; no distribution or NAV adjustment may be double counted.
candidates.r2_gate: Price/NAV/premium-discount history, SGE/exchange calendar and market-status records, actual spread/cost/no-fill inputs and a stress/correlation map against all other sleeves.

shared_r1_to_r2_gates: Freeze the exact universe, selection rules, weight formula, timing and replacement policy before examining outcomes.
Use authorized point-in-time price/NAV, distribution, corporate-action, index-membership and market-status data.
Model actual broker commission, bid-ask, taxes, settlement, T+1/no-fill states and ETF premium/discount rather than fund expense ratios alone.
Reconcile price and income/distribution events exactly once; no cash-receipt target or automatic reinvestment is permitted.
Run out-of-sample total-return, drawdown, turnover and stress tests, followed by independent review and prospective paper reconciliation.
conclusion: Selected product mechanics are now documented at R1 for a limited five-ETF research set. No candidate passes R2 or is approved for a personal strategy; the public-price candidate rule fails the all-window 5% stability condition.
